metadata.title: Micron Stock Drops Again. Surging Memory Prices Aren’t All Good News.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Micron Stock Drops Again. Surging Memory Prices Aren’t All Good News.
Micron Technology was sliding early Friday. A warning from Intel about the surging cost of memory chips is a reminder of its extraordinary profitability but might also provoke worries about the sustainability of the hardware cycle.
